senses.definition: Fiction in which advanced technology or science is a key element.
senses.example: Now this applies especially to Science-Fiction, in which the revealed truths of Science may be given, interwoven with a pleasing story which may itself be poetical and true—thus circulating a knowledge of the Poetry of Science, clothed in a garb of the Poetry of Life.

senses.definition: Technology that, while theoretically possible, is not yet practical.
senses.example: Despite decades of research, mass-market personal aircraft are still science fiction.

senses.definition: Of or pertaining to this genre.
